title: Let hard grants win over semantic risk classification
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He judges semantic risk of a proposed action and applies hard AccessPolicy grants so hard grants always win. He verifies decision / hard_won / grants_unchanged.
implementation: Product verb `judge` with risk_question_id + required_abilities/grants; hard AccessPolicy gates over semantic risk.
validation: user_story scenarios with per-scenario cassettes; hard expects on decision keys.
